identification: Pale yellow, straight-grained rough-sawn live-edge slab, about 2 m long and roughly 40-50 cm wide, one of three adjacent slabs (lots 1117, 1118, 1119). Consistent with Huon pine (or similar pale timber such as celery top or King Billy); species not confirmed from photo. No figure or birdseye visible; a deep split/notch on the left near the top.

viewing_check: Check species and quality: smell and cut-edge colour (Huon pine is pale yellow with a strong sweet scent), look for birdseye or fine figure, thickness (photo cannot show), the split at the top left, checks, and true width and length.
